decisions.reason: Retaining the zero-ohm I2C conditioning resistors does not change the interboard connector partition, connector types, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The I2C conditioning decision does not change battery protection; the same-message acceptance of R7 and R8 is already represented independently in this Requirement.
The zero-ohm resistors condition the I2C lines and do not alter native USB data lines, connector sourceability, or the D+/D- interboard route.
The existing same-message BOM Event records approval of R7 and R8 but omits the client's decision to retain R10 and R11 as zero-ohm I2C voltage-spike-conditioning resistors.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: No that all sounds good, so you can leave it as is.

value_updates.approved_component_justification: R7 and R8 are required by DW01A for current sense, RC filtering, and chip protection; R10 and R11 are 0Ω I2C resistors retained for voltage-spike conditioning.

decisions.reason: The I2C resistor-retention decision does not change the battery NTC terminal, connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
The I2C conditioning resistors are unrelated to the 5V boost converter's enable control, pull-down, default state, or powered loads.
The source decision does not alter the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated-LED policy.
The I2C resistor-retention decision does not change the selected addressable-LED family or its data GPIO.
